environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No reverse proxy adding security headers. Application runs with default Flask settings. Admin interface accessible on internal network (10.0.0.0/8). Database accepts arbitrary string values in the 'value' column of pending_migrations table including values with target_type='display_html'.

config.network: VPC with internal subnet, no WAF
config.database: SQLite local file, no input validation on writes
